name: lint demo: wordings that lower agreement

veto_rules.text: (a) Skip when move_5min_toward is greater than 0.4 times band_width.
(b) Skip when the maximum of last_12_moves is greater than 5.
(c) Skip when alerts_last_3h is 0 and spread is above 0.3.
(d) Skip when vol_24h is below 15 and band_width is below 8.
(e) Skip when time_utc is after 20:00 and spread is 0.6.
(f) Skip when move_24h_toward is above 10 and alerts_last_3h is above 2.
